title: Gate profile derivation on physical prerequisites
description: Implement a fail-closed derivation gate that keeps PRD 26 disabled while physical materials, repeated-observation baseline, evidence thresholds, and correction policy from source issues 13, 07, and 09 remain unresolved.
acceptanceCriteria: The current gate always refuses profile derivation and calibrated generation
Refusal names missing printer, stock, fresh-sheet inventory, measuring tools, repeated observations, thresholds, and correction policy as applicable
Synthetic, demo, PDF-structure, and one-off fixture data cannot close the gate
Gate state is derived from explicit policy/prerequisite records rather than a hidden feature flag
Refusal performs no profile write and makes no physical suitability claim

steps.details: Represent each unresolved physical prerequisite and policy deliverable with a stable ID, source issue reference, and actionable missing-state explanation.
Return a structured blocked result unless every required real-evidence and approved-policy record exists; reject demo and synthetic substitutes.
Disable derivation and calibrated-output actions while presenting semantic, keyboard-readable unmet-prerequisite text.
Verify absent, partial, demo, synthetic, and malformed prerequisite states all refuse without mutation or physical claims.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; implement only the current fail-closed gate and focused refusal tests.

PHYSICAL BLOCKERS (source issues, not generated task IDs): issue 13 must establish available materials, issue 07 must establish a repeated-observation baseline, and issue 09 must establish evidence thresholds and correction policy.
BLOCKED: no known printer, stock, fresh sheets, measuring tools, repeated observations, evidence thresholds, or resolved correction policy exist.
This task may implement refusal behavior but cannot mark any physical prerequisite resolved.
